reported_acceptance_basis: The ten exact owners are verified against original successful normal, independent kernel, full environment-owned type/axiom inventories, source plus five output fingerprints, fixed pipeline and current target-source receipts. Two checkpoint09 reuse references add no owner or declaration; compilation was not repeated.

audit_lane_scope.rule: Recover exact original audit lanes and owned-module lists from raw receipts. Do not infer declaration counts from ten accepted owners or the number of data blocks.
audit_lane_scope.owned_attribution: Original environment-owned module field and complete audited inventory, including generated auxiliaries; no namespace-prefix, filename-prefix or block-count filter.

references.hash_observation_basis: Exact original final stdout reuse pointer, preserving full path, source, SHA and accepted-owner set; mapped to the checkpoint09 member. This is not the hash of an observed JSON capture.

noncounting_pipeline_reuse.rule: Join both exact prior-group pointers in checkpoint09 by full original path, source_commit, SHA256 and accepted-owner set. Base011070 and Base071142 share a source commit but are distinct receipts; Range051070 and Range071090 likewise. Earlier groups add zero owners/declarations to checkpoint11.

counting_rule: Export receipts under exactly eight completed Base071142 and two completed Range071090 stage roots, plus their two original final pipelines. Both original tasks succeeded and all ten normal records report zero project errors. Only the exact ten observed owners may be counted after raw receipt verification. Reused earlier groups add no owners/declarations. Do not infer an aggregate Base/Range theorem or whole-table/NPY acceptance.
scope_exclusions: Range091 and every later Range group, even if subsequently completed
Any full TypedArchiveRange or TypedBaseGeometry aggregate stage
All Crossing, ActualIntegral, Barycentric, TypedKey and OriginalNpy stages/results

submission_gate: Root must independently verify checkpoint10, bind its actual archive SHA to the sole required argument and plan, and publish the exact checkpoint11 script/plan before a single source-bound read-only export invocation. This preparation neither submits a task nor compiles any owner.
command_argument_validation: Exactly one mandatory argument of 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Before receipt collection, require checkpoint-10.tar.xz to be a regular non-symlink file and its SHA256 to equal the Root-approved argument. Record that verified actual hash in EXPORT_MANIFEST.json. No default, hash guess or auto-sealing is permitted.
